1. take note (i)
we were between two worlds, hot tensions blurred -- your reflection waiting on the other side,
this game of hide and seek, with a smile so bleak, your suffering so innocent, too sweet; as i wait
for you here to find me.
bending space, erasing waves and patterns and figurines in my head. instead of the lure, its the
chase til we come face to face with our golden boy. perfection, outraced his dimension to meet
me in mine. shows me his palm, shows me a sign. synchronized moments treading still like
untouched water, untampered thrill, fear of self and what's real. we are the same, but you don't
speak like i do, you make this a game. a game to me as we relinquish what? spirit? soul? an
exchange? my hearts felt better days, but i already knew that everything takes time to get used to.
you are living in thoughts of Disney, mind in wonderland, hoping for an elysian eternity. the
stains on the bubble you call home is ruble open for all to see. you roam through make-believe
determined for fantasy. you know i live there too. you know i paint the sky blue. you know you
feel it too. you know i know what's true. you know i believe you too. praise the golden rule that
this life has taught you, the time its bought you, the lessons not yet caught up to you. yes -- you
are Disney, but even there you'll never be free. open up to this world and i can promise you'll get
to where you need to be. you are living in the wrong life.
look at me: i am made of magic, its real the static is rising. i’m finding the fire more & more as
time becomes me. death in stardust, heavy blush on kitschy memories and hickeys formed out of
mourning. distasteful blessings but beauty all the same. i blame the magic, i blame the static. i
blame the unholy halo on unholy earth, mind set to rebirth in ash and flame. shame the turmoil,
shame the outskirts of your memories that linger in my shadow -- as if I'm caught in a
thunderstorm. reborn. reborn. the journey mumbling under your stumbling tongue too fast to hear
a sound but too slow for me, raging flow through distorted fate or distorted destiny. you decide.
my mind is flawed as yours is flawed. our scorning ghosts twist us through silence, through thin
air, through the stares you make and break me in two, through ash, through storm, through birth,
through my unholy halo on unholy earth.
2. take note (ii)
utopia is as thin as glass, ready to break on memories racing by too fast. utopia is not a dream, its
a clean state of mind. utopia isn't perfection or the most beautiful, utopia is satisfaction,
contentment, peace. at least stay on this heaven before we find utopia on the next. as utopia is not
a place, it lives in every desire in special taste, in every connection we make and in each breath
we take when we stop focusing so much on our own hearts and start focusing on ones that don't
belong to us.
because in these moments i find myself ticking too fast, blasted out of sync, thinking myself into
the ground. when i was younger i thought i knew what was needed to be found but i was wrong.
exploring poems, new songs, blue love, true love, anything and everything. its only myself to
find what i’m looking for, no magic man or door is there for curing me. if freedom is a choice
then i guess i haven’t always made the right one. so IT IS now, it must be, and not whats been
done. now, now, now. there is a part of me and you that knows how to do this. never a simple fix
or kiss but a flick on the lips to say: "i WILL be better. for ALWAYS, til forever." my three rules:
watch out for signs and trust them, do not question what you find and have more compassion in
the world (and for YOU) for all things take time. the last one is hard cos i like to live on the
defense but patience exists for a reason. put yourself first if you need to, be unapologetic through
it too, cos one day all of it will really make sense. listen to YOUR voice, listen out for freedom
as it becomes the right choice. one day, right?
let's see. focus. cos at least for me, ill fight for that, ill rise up, rise for freedom. i will rise. i will
be free. for i have FAITH in this eternity --
3. watch your shadow
I watch your shadow
Crawl up your back
Track flawed skin
But perfect --
(Whatever that means)
I see you in my head
A splotch of red paint
Tattooed to some foreign memory
But you are here
Your clear sight
Might make me take a bite
of the purity I may have destroyed
The uproar of my desire
Fire, fire--
Too hot,
Too hot for you?
I fucked this up
And I'll never get it back
Track my flawed face
Melting into your uneven silence
The riot
In my mind
Will destroy us
Both.
But I am so in love
with you. I cannot
Let you
Go.
4. spinning into you
The waves crash on
Your whistling brow
Like dust.
You remember the ocean like
I do? Smiling and nodding
Isn't yes.
Your naked wet figure
Diving into black water
and I stand by the shore
Afraid to get in. I'm
Spinning into you and
Watching you is enough.
It's always been enough.
You look over and your cheeks
Slide north and I remain
Stagnant. Seaweed hair
Scales on unbroken calluses
Your fingers; rough
As usual. Shiver
Down my spine as you wink
Before getting too close
And falling back in to the sea.
Free fall without gravity
I fall on hard and sharp.
I fall harder than you know.
Tinsel mind made from storm
I think more than you know.
It got dark and the approaching
Midnight roars. It's angry at us
For not being open
And demanding our desires.
I'm still just looking at you.
I look more than you know.
If I ran now I could out
Run you easily. But the sky
Will follow each and every breath.
I can't escape the nightfall
I can escape you
But like clouds and stars
You are forever printed above.
And you will always be too far too reach
And you will always trick me into
Catching you.
But that's the only thing I'm not
Fast enough for.
My shadow is dragging
Me down.

pull me and extract my glance

maybe i’m changing

sometimes it gets so hard to breathe

god dies and we’ll be free

we’ll come to see
the times are changing

only us

only us

god cries in the end

the angel will send
god dies and we’ll be free
just you wait we’ll all be free

History,
Blank memory,
Looking back,
That wasn’t me.
Do you know?
Oh I wish,
Fix this history.
Fix my history.
Time is such a funny thing,
Our past only a fling,
We play to play each other
Love is but a cover
How could we know?
Fleeting cries we blow,
And row gently,
Into the afterlife
Into the afterlife.
Ripe blossom
From wet trees
Sunken breeze
Without reason
Blooming season
Each day weakened
Say our hymn
As our lights dim.
Time is such a funny thing,
Our past only a fling,
We play to play each other
Love is but a cover
How could we know?
Fleeting cries we blow,
And row gently,
Into the afterlife
Into the afterlife.
Tell me one more time

Sell my soul
for one more chance-
Time is such a funny thing,
Our past only a fling,
We play to play each other
Love is but a cover
How could we know?
Fleeting cries we blow,

Into the afterlife
Into our afterlife.

What are you waiting for?

Nothing works in this world.

What are you waiting for?

Can keep us for falling

I’m falling,

9. I think I know you well
If i know you,
and i think i still
know you well.
I know that there
is nothing that you want more
than to get over me.
Even in the fault-line,
you think of me,
there is nothing you wouldn’t
do to stay away from me.
I know this time between
us will get
larger, and larger.
Until we fade into oblivion.
I’ll watch you rise,
and you’ll watch me fall.
And then you will
remember
how we used to play this dance.
or maybe i’m the only one
who still thinks of you.
Probably,
I mean why would you want to?
When I feel
I don’t deserve you,
it makes me feel I don’t
deserve anyone.
Maybe I don’t,
Maybe.
10. what a strange feeling
what a strange feeling
to be not in love with you
but to accept that
we won’t end up
again,
and in love.
above the fair skin,
your highlight
is made of ash,
crippled stash
of homegrown practices.
practice me
into what you want,
make me up
i can’t front,
this duplicity.
i’m blind but still see
this hypocrisy.
don’t abandon me yet,
in some horror memory
where we fall
in love like
lost lovers
living for another life.
i watched you bloom,
and became
dedicated to your perfume,
and i know that life
is only fiction,
sent from my own imagined hell,
And day by day, i trap
myself into the same,
state of denial,
i know that i love you.
and i wish
you would
love me
too.
Because in another life,
we would have gotten
through it all,
and deeply i love
we would have fallen.
I never got that chance from you,
so I guess you leave me
here wishing
you would love me too.
11. bloom
the white walls
lack paintings
fall to a depleted white,
i am depleted
as i wake
in pistachio shell’s
and silly dreams
that tell me reality is fake.
now,
i have nothing at stake,
I’ve given it all up.
maybe its the rare breed
of insanity, i avoid.
but I’ve done my part,
what i can,
and my heart can’t break again.
watch me reveal
the timed delights
in silent moon
as tonight’s eclipse
will bloom, will bloom, will bloom.
i was not made to love at all.
i was made to break and fall.
will bloom, will bloom,
it’s too soon,
it was always too soon.
12. something out of a fairytale
tonight
i dream of you
(not you) but of you
there,
behind the hourglass
of my speeding memory.
all those years:
and in a moment (or less)
we were back there,
mouth on mouth
tongues fighting for freedom
something,
out of a fairytale,
like romeo or juliet,
the way you swung me
around into your arms
as you kissed me
as if you never left
as if i never said
goodbye forever,
but as if we were whole
and in love
and found each other again.
that bare dream i had,
thinking we would ever be,
casting me into a tremble,
casting me into you, again,
time such a funny thing,
it took me here,
where you tell me
"i love you”
one more time
13. when will i stop
when will i stop pretending
that it doesn’t affect me
the skies are descending
into war.
take me to where
i cannot hide
anymore.
14. angels
cleaning tar under the nail bed
another reason to get in my head
flashing red from the words you said
waiting until i can crawl into your bed
the dizzy ride into morning blaze
no words to confide, sin my haze
my body sick heavy and bare
i’ll leave soon don’t want you to care.
you think about the world in terms of angels
what they could do for you
what they will do for you
when the only one you know
is treading lightly in the past
can barely see straight
but brain beating so fast
can’t manage to escape the race
i thought if i create
then the world will take me
my hands are so shaky for us to make
what we need, so free me
i’m sick of being sick
my bones in a nervous tick
the rhythm of my internal kick
won’t bring us out of this
there is a way that we can speak
that makes me loose myself
because i’m in love with loving you
these months ill have to live without you
i pull my hair back tight
pounding heart knowing i’m stepping out
to get in and my car, blind this sight
as i breathe in such sweet but bitter cloud
15. silence
Silence.
Your mouth lays
dormant. Mine is aching.
Silence.
Your drawn-out heartbeats are barely
noticeable under mutual
heavy breathing.
Silence.
Your eyes flutter
like child’s first sunlight, but
you were born too late to feel this way
and I know your mind is otherwise sealed shut.
Silence
Your vision is of me watching you.
it’s rare I can no longer see the street marks of
your skin as it trails the pathway to your uneasy mind
as you rock backwards and forwards through rendering of
words I cannot fathom to speak; moments like this tell me "in time."
Silence.
Your silence is a curse, that pushes me into you.
Your silence is a vile demon, that pushes me into you.
Your silence is a pain and stake to the heart, that forces me into you.
Your silence cannot be real, since if you would speak you’d mutter something
stupid, something benign, something meaningful.
But our silence is limited by experience, limited by my paranoia.
and your silence is us falling in love.
Silence.
I cannot bare another moment without your silence,
presence illuminates everything,
raw presence,
raw silence,
reality.
Your silence is real.
16. in my dreams i hold you
in my dreams i hold you
your scent of water and wood
the oceans crash a silent blue
more hope than i ever could
i see a nightmare rising
where you’re calling out to me
and i told you i’m trying
to let go of you and heal
the memories are troubling
i remember each flash of you
i know our ship has sunken
but i want to get back to you
i rise over you my love
into the fallen sun
i rise over you, and above
the noise was never done
in my dreams i rise
and fate talks me down
theres no hope, it’s my demise
and the sky wears an ugly frown
you hear the words I’m speaking
but your ears are stitched and shut
make it a habit to see me teaching
how to falter and open back up these cuts
16. It hurts even when I talk to you
it hurts even when i talk to you
don’t know how to feel better
i ask the winds to take me too
don’t know how to feel better
The tide washes us into the sea
Your body swimming up close to me
The rise and fall, brightest of skies
With no one else, where else would we fly
This favourite place all tangled up in you
Unfamiliar, it seems, but know it’s all true
Broken blue hues of morning bloom into day
Sleep no more and stay into eternity where we lay.
Close, and close.
Give me your time.
I want you so close
and love me in time.
17. last vice
Do you remember how this all goes,
into the throws of each and
every
blow.
Fake me into starlight
Heaven is
nothing but
a death stare.
I murmur and lay my mind
down onto the thick
concrete fortress
of solitude.
ain’t nothing will pull me out
this time.
and does this stem from
missing you?
pathetic blues.
the best that can come
from crawling in your crawlspace
is the drool
of lonely --
the sound my bones make
against the tendons
as they cry out against
the meekness of the universe.
well versed in the wrecking
pitiful stains of time.
i will wither away.
fray, nothing, why bother
with it all, i’ll call you and
conjure the thoughts that
make me feel worse
and miss you harder.
i want to dismiss
your memory, your arches,
your cobblestones and
make a new shrine.
line the cardboard cutouts
with real furniture,
churning blue
into a pleasant forest green.
i want to be free,
not seen from the eyes
of my internal black eye
cultivating poison,
stirring the abyss
like it’s an empty
cauldron.
tell me, my friend,
or send me anything
that isn’t
an open palm
sore and dry and empty,
reaching out, endlessly,
some fiend,
Desire is a
cunt.
18. and I’d say
and i’d say
maybe i’ve loved too much
the stronger i feel
the stronger the fuss
when i die,
marry me
by the largest oak tree
we’ll set out to sea
the addict within us
will destroy our trust
the time and the place
for the faces we break
for the moments we trace
into a cloud of haste
and we’ll lose you
for something more pure
i never wondered
how i would survive
i only knew
how to be alive
and it takes some to try
from not falling too high
as the light hits the sky
before our bodies divide
in silence
i’ll say forgive me
i won’t live for the plea
when i die the devil collects
he was always watching me
19. chessboard
the ANTI depressants
are wearing me out
he confesses
he didn't mean to shout
the more i wake up
the more I see
How much I'm shaken up
this wasn't make believe
it was all real
it was, it was
and it was all real
it was, it was
and it was all for you
for you, for you, for you
and it was all real for you
I was waiting
on our chessboard
of broken pieces
you were bored
and I felt useless
but I stood there
as your queen -
the most beautiful thing
your kings ever seen
I wish it just didn't mean
everything to me.
20. cupid
your body a train of thought
the rush of smoke
like some overdose
out comes the doves we had caught
in a love we never bought
but paid for as it arose
in petals falling
for each time we fought
little cupid make me melt
your arrow primed (alive, lively) and laced
if only felt as good as it taste
you aimed and took me down
you aimed and i hit your ground
in such a sweet embrace
bare beauty barren sound
bare beauty no barren crown
bare beauty breaking down
I hover above what we could be
enough to blow out the misery
enough to breathe in the mystery
these are the days we face
within the temple we prayed
our paved, gold crusted race
tell me something cupid
why do you fly alone?
giggling in a stupor
he said he didn't have them bones
tell me something cupid
where do you call home?
he shook his head
and wiped his brow
whispered he didn't know
how we do it, and flew off
cackling he'd rather drown
tell me something cupid I shouted out
"why did you leave yourself this fate"
he blew me a kiss and said goodbye
"I'm sorry baby you chose wrong
this time and I'm sorry baby it's all too late"

1. take note (i)
we were between two worlds, hot tensions blurred -- your reflection waiting on the other side,
this game of hide and seek, with a smile so bleak, your suffering so innocent, too sweet; as i wait
for you here to find me.
bending space, erasing waves and patterns and figurines in my head. instead of the lure, its the
chase til we come face to face with our golden boy. perfection, outraced his dimension to meet
me in mine. shows me his palm, shows me a sign. synchronized moments treading still like
untouched water, untampered thrill, fear of self and what's real. we are the same, but you don't
speak like i do, you make this a game. a game to me as we relinquish what? spirit? soul? an
exchange? my hearts felt better days, but i already knew that everything takes time to get used to.
you are living in thoughts of Disney, mind in wonderland, hoping for an elysian eternity. the
stains on the bubble you call home is ruble open for all to see. you roam through make-believe
determined for fantasy. you know i live there too. you know i paint the sky blue. you know you
feel it too. you know i know what's true. you know i believe you too. praise the golden rule that
this life has taught you, the time its bought you, the lessons not yet caught up to you. yes -- you
are Disney, but even there you'll never be free. open up to this world and i can promise you'll get
to where you need to be. you are living in the wrong life.
look at me: i am made of magic, its real the static is rising. i’m finding the fire more & more as
time becomes me. death in stardust, heavy blush on kitschy memories and hickeys formed out of
mourning. distasteful blessings but beauty all the same. i blame the magic, i blame the static. i
blame the unholy halo on unholy earth, mind set to rebirth in ash and flame. shame the turmoil,
shame the outskirts of your memories that linger in my shadow -- as if I'm caught in a
thunderstorm. reborn. reborn. the journey mumbling under your stumbling tongue too fast to hear
a sound but too slow for me, raging flow through distorted fate or distorted destiny. you decide.
my mind is flawed as yours is flawed. our scorning ghosts twist us through silence, through thin
air, through the stares you make and break me in two, through ash, through storm, through birth,
through my unholy halo on unholy earth.
2. take note (ii)
utopia is as thin as glass, ready to break on memories racing by too fast. utopia is not a dream, its
a clean state of mind. utopia isn't perfection or the most beautiful, utopia is satisfaction,
contentment, peace. at least stay on this heaven before we find utopia on the next. as utopia is not
a place, it lives in every desire in special taste, in every connection we make and in each breath
we take when we stop focusing so much on our own hearts and start focusing on ones that don't
belong to us.
because in these moments i find myself ticking too fast, blasted out of sync, thinking myself into
the ground. when i was younger i thought i knew what was needed to be found but i was wrong.
exploring poems, new songs, blue love, true love, anything and everything. its only myself to
find what i’m looking for, no magic man or door is there for curing me. if freedom is a choice
then i guess i haven’t always made the right one. so IT IS now, it must be, and not whats been
done. now, now, now. there is a part of me and you that knows how to do this. never a simple fix
or kiss but a flick on the lips to say: "i WILL be better. for ALWAYS, til forever." my three rules:
watch out for signs and trust them, do not question what you find and have more compassion in
the world (and for YOU) for all things take time. the last one is hard cos i like to live on the
defense but patience exists for a reason. put yourself first if you need to, be unapologetic through
it too, cos one day all of it will really make sense. listen to YOUR voice, listen out for freedom
as it becomes the right choice. one day, right?
let's see. focus. cos at least for me, ill fight for that, ill rise up, rise for freedom. i will rise. i will
be free. for i have FAITH in this eternity --

goodbye forever,
but as if we were whole
and in love
and found each other again.
that bare dream i had,
thinking we would ever be,
casting me into a tremble,
casting me into you, again,
time such a funny thing,
it took me here,
where you tell me
"i love you”
one more time
13. when will i stop
when will i stop pretending
that it doesn’t affect me
the skies are descending
into war.
take me to where
i cannot hide
anymore.
14. angels
cleaning tar under the nail bed
another reason to get in my head
flashing red from the words you said
waiting until i can crawl into your bed
the dizzy ride into morning blaze
no words to confide, sin my haze
my body sick heavy and bare
i’ll leave soon don’t want you to care.
you think about the world in terms of angels
what they could do for you
what they will do for you
when the only one you know
is treading lightly in the past
can barely see straight
but brain beating so fast
can’t manage to escape the race
i thought if i create
then the world will take me
my hands are so shaky for us to make
what we need, so free me
i’m sick of being sick
my bones in a nervous tick
the rhythm of my internal kick
won’t bring us out of this
there is a way that we can speak
that makes me loose myself
because i’m in love with loving you
these months ill have to live without you
i pull my hair back tight
pounding heart knowing i’m stepping out
to get in and my car, blind this sight
as i breathe in such sweet but bitter cloud
15. silence
Silence.
Your mouth lays
dormant. Mine is aching.
Silence.
Your drawn-out heartbeats are barely
noticeable under mutual
heavy breathing.
Silence.
Your eyes flutter
like child’s first sunlight, but
you were born too late to feel this way
and I know your mind is otherwise sealed shut.
Silence
Your vision is of me watching you.
it’s rare I can no longer see the street marks of
your skin as it trails the pathway to your uneasy mind
as you rock backwards and forwards through rendering of
words I cannot fathom to speak; moments like this tell me "in time."
Silence.
Your silence is a curse, that pushes me into you.
Your silence is a vile demon, that pushes me into you.
Your silence is a pain and stake to the heart, that forces me into you.
Your silence cannot be real, since if you would speak you’d mutter something
stupid, something benign, something meaningful.
But our silence is limited by experience, limited by my paranoia.
and your silence is us falling in love.
Silence.
I cannot bare another moment without your silence,
presence illuminates everything,
raw presence,
raw silence,
reality.
Your silence is real.
16. in my dreams i hold you
in my dreams i hold you
your scent of water and wood
the oceans crash a silent blue
more hope than i ever could
i see a nightmare rising
where you’re calling out to me
and i told you i’m trying
to let go of you and heal
the memories are troubling
i remember each flash of you
i know our ship has sunken
but i want to get back to you
i rise over you my love
into the fallen sun
i rise over you, and above
the noise was never done
in my dreams i rise
and fate talks me down
theres no hope, it’s my demise
and the sky wears an ugly frown
you hear the words I’m speaking
but your ears are stitched and shut
make it a habit to see me teaching
how to falter and open back up these cuts
16. It hurts even when I talk to you
it hurts even when i talk to you
don’t know how to feel better
i ask the winds to take me too
don’t know how to feel better
The tide washes us into the sea
Your body swimming up close to me
The rise and fall, brightest of skies
With no one else, where else would we fly
This favourite place all tangled up in you
Unfamiliar, it seems, but know it’s all true
Broken blue hues of morning bloom into day
Sleep no more and stay into eternity where we lay.
Close, and close.
Give me your time.
I want you so close
and love me in time.
17. last vice
Do you remember how this all goes,
into the throws of each and
every
blow.
Fake me into starlight
Heaven is
nothing but
a death stare.
I murmur and lay my mind
down onto the thick
concrete fortress
of solitude.
ain’t nothing will pull me out
this time.
and does this stem from
missing you?
pathetic blues.
the best that can come
from crawling in your crawlspace
is the drool
of lonely --
the sound my bones make
against the tendons
as they cry out against
the meekness of the universe.
well versed in the wrecking
pitiful stains of time.
i will wither away.
fray, nothing, why bother
with it all, i’ll call you and
conjure the thoughts that
make me feel worse
and miss you harder.
i want to dismiss
your memory, your arches,
your cobblestones and
make a new shrine.
line the cardboard cutouts
with real furniture,
churning blue
into a pleasant forest green.
i want to be free,
not seen from the eyes
of my internal black eye
cultivating poison,
stirring the abyss
like it’s an empty
cauldron.
tell me, my friend,
or send me anything
that isn’t
an open palm
sore and dry and empty,
reaching out, endlessly,
some fiend,
Desire is a
cunt.
18. and I’d say
and i’d say
maybe i’ve loved too much
the stronger i feel
the stronger the fuss
when i die,
marry me
by the largest oak tree
we’ll set out to sea
the addict within us
will destroy our trust
the time and the place
for the faces we break
for the moments we trace
into a cloud of haste
and we’ll lose you
for something more pure
i never wondered
how i would survive
i only knew
how to be alive
and it takes some to try
from not falling too high
as the light hits the sky
before our bodies divide
in silence
i’ll say forgive me
i won’t live for the plea
when i die the devil collects
he was always watching me
19. chessboard
the ANTI depressants
are wearing me out
he confesses
he didn't mean to shout
the more i wake up
the more I see
How much I'm shaken up
this wasn't make believe
it was all real
it was, it was
and it was all real
it was, it was
and it was all for you
for you, for you, for you
and it was all real for you
I was waiting
on our chessboard
of broken pieces
you were bored
and I felt useless
but I stood there
as your queen -
the most beautiful thing
your kings ever seen
I wish it just didn't mean
everything to me.
20. cupid
your body a train of thought
the rush of smoke
like some overdose
out comes the doves we had caught
in a love we never bought
but paid for as it arose
in petals falling
for each time we fought
little cupid make me melt
your arrow primed (alive, lively) and laced
if only felt as good as it taste
you aimed and took me down
you aimed and i hit your ground
in such a sweet embrace
bare beauty barren sound
bare beauty no barren crown
bare beauty breaking down
I hover above what we could be
enough to blow out the misery
enough to breathe in the mystery
these are the days we face
within the temple we prayed
our paved, gold crusted race
tell me something cupid
why do you fly alone?
giggling in a stupor
he said he didn't have them bones
tell me something cupid
where do you call home?
he shook his head
and wiped his brow
whispered he didn't know
how we do it, and flew off
cackling he'd rather drown
tell me something cupid I shouted out
"why did you leave yourself this fate"
he blew me a kiss and said goodbye

this time and I'm sorry baby it's all too late"
